Discuss the strengths and weaknesses of psychological techniques to manage schizophrenia.
You should include a conclusion in your answer. 
Psychology and consumer behaviour

text: Schizophrenia can be treated with medical techniques and it can be managed with psychological
techniques. Medical treatments include the use of electro-convulsive therapy (ECT) and drugs
such as antipsychotics and atypical antipsychotics. Schizophrenia can be managed psychologically
using token economy and cognitive-behavioural therapy (CBT).
